# Secure Payment Gateway Integration  

A robust, compliance-first integration solution for e-commerce platforms, designed to handle high-volume transactions with zero-trust architecture and real-time fraud detection. Built with a focus on SOC2, GDPR, and PCI DSS compliance, this project ensures end-to-end encryption, tokenization, and dynamic access control for payment processing pipelines.  

## Badges  
[![Compliance](https://example.com/compliance-badge)](https://example.com) [![CI/CD](https://example.com/ci-badge)](https://example.com) [![Security](https://example.com/secure-badge)](https://example.com)  

## Tech Stack  
- **Encryption**: AES-256-GCM, RSA-OAEP-256, TLS 1.3  
- **Auth**: OAuth 2.0, JWT with HS256, SCIM  
- **Network**: Zero-trust microsegmentation, API gateways with rate limiting  
- **SIEM**: Splunk for real-time log correlation, ELK stack for audit trails  
- **Payment Gateways**: Stripe, PayPal, Adyen (webhooks + REST APIs)  
- **Frameworks**: Go (for concurrency), Python (for rule engines), Node.js (for event streaming)  

## Configuration  
Set environment variables for secrets, encryption keys, and SIEM integrations. Example:  
```bash  
export PAYMENT_SECRET=your-encrypted-key  
export SIEM_ENDPOINT=https://splunk-intake.example.com  
```  
Configure payment gateway webhooks with HMAC signing and validate TLS certificates at runtime.  

## Getting Started  
Clone the repository and install dependencies:  
```bash  
git clone https://github.com/secure-payment-gateway.git  
cd secure-payment-gateway  
go mod tidy  
npm install  
```  
Initialize the database schema and register SIEM connectors via the admin console.  

## Usage / Examples  
```python  
# Tokenize card data before sending to payment gateway  
token = encrypt_card_data(card_number, aes_key)  
response = stripe_api.post("/charges", data={"token": token})  
```  
Implement dynamic access control using RBAC and attribute-based policies to restrict payment processing to trusted IPs and roles.  

## Testing  
Run unit tests for encryption/decryption workflows and integration tests for webhook validation. Use OWASP ZAP to scan for vulnerabilities and simulate MITM attacks. Example:  
```bash  
go test -v ./pkg/encryption  
npm run test:security  
```  
Monitor SIEM for anomalies during transactions and trigger incident response protocols automatically.
